_why: Whisper mishears the occasional word, often where the reader's accent and a technical term collide. Captions must match what was actually said, so corrections live here rather than being hand-edited into the generated caption files, where the next transcription run would silently revert them. scripts/transcribe-narration.mjs applies these after every run. Prefer `before` over `occurrence` whenever the misheard word appears more than once in a segment: ordinals are counted among the tokens that currently match, so correcting one renumbers the rest and the next run hits the wrong token. `before` anchors to the following word and is stable.
